in_sanskrit.name: Dhanjee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's wealth, prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dhanjee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Dhanjee is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dhan’ which means wealth and ‘jee’ meaning god. It signifies that the person named Dhanjee is blessed with God's wealth and prosperity in their life.
